scope: Bound Gnosis Moloch indexing to 10,000 blocks per invocation. Oversized explicit ranges fail before provider or database access; automatic backlog catch-up advances only the committed range and resumes from the checkpoint on the next invocation.
isolation: All tests use mocked provider/database boundaries. No network provider, database, candidate, legacy service, or persistent Compose resource was used.
limitations: The Gnosis indexer still uses its legacy shared database path; this change does not provide a dedicated worker identity or runtime least-privilege grants.
